description: This file defines the TimeMachine class used for recording timing changes of MediaAnalyticItem properties within the Android media metrics system. It includes class definitions, methods for managing property histories, thread safety mechanisms, and dump functions for diagnostics.

classes.name: TimeMachine
classes.description: Main class for recording and managing timing changes of media analytic item properties.

classes.name: TimeMachine::KeyHistory
classes.description: Represents the history of properties for a specific key, including permission checks and value retrieval.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads for printing monostate, pair, and variant types.

methods.name: TimeMachine::put
methods.description: Records all properties from an item into the TimeMachine log.

methods.name: TimeMachine::get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property value for a given key and property name.

methods.name: TimeMachine::dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state of the TimeMachine as a string, limited by line count.
